The company issued a redemption notice for the entire $350M outstanding of its 4.50% Senior Secured Notes due 2026, using the proceeds from the new offering and available cash to complete the payout on September 28, 2026.
This transaction reduces total outstanding corporate secured debt by $125M and extends the debt maturity profile out to 2031.
Following this redemption, Ready Capital's sole remaining 2026 corporate debt maturity will be a $100M obligation due in November, which it plans to satisfy using cash on hand.
